note: The church's own FAQ, verbatim from shilohchurchbpt.org (July 2026). Note it says prayer begins 8:15 AM — the homepage hero says 8:30; see data/church.json note.

faq.a: We are located at 477 Broad Street, Bridgeport, CT 06604. You'll find us in the heart of downtown, easily accessible from all major routes.
On Sundays, our Prayer service begins at 8:15 AM, followed by Worship at 9:00 AM. We also offer Monday–Friday prayer at 6:00 AM and 8:00 PM.
We offer free parking in the church lot and nearby designated areas. Look for parking attendants to guide you when you arrive.

faq.q: Is there something for my kids?
faq.a: Absolutely! Our Children's Ministry offers safe, engaging, and age-appropriate activities where kids can learn about God's love while having fun.

faq.q: What does a Typical Service Look Like?
faq.a: Services include uplifting worship, prayer, and a Bible-based message designed to encourage and inspire. Expect a warm, friendly environment where you can come as you are.

faq.q: How do I join a ministry?
faq.a: We have many ministry opportunities—from music to outreach to hospitality. Speak to a ministry leader after service or contact our office to get connected.

faq.q: How do I join a small group?
faq.a: Small groups meet during the week for Bible study, prayer, and fellowship. Visit our welcome center or sign up online to find a group that fits your schedule.

faq.q: How can I get involved in serving?
faq.a: Serving is a great way to grow and connect with others. We have opportunities in worship, children's programs, outreach, and more. Fill out a volunteer form or talk to our leaders to get started.
